name: Trace-based SDF Rendering
definition: A rendering technique that traces rays through a sparse voxel model using Signed Distance Fields (SDF) to determine hit depth and voxel ID, then retrieves color from the hit voxel's SH coefficients.
summary: Trace-based SDF Rendering traces rays through sparse voxels using Signed Distance Fields for precise geometry, retrieving color from spherical harmonic coefficients to distinguish it from volumetric integration or mesh rendering.
